content: Open an agent to use the sections your role allows. With view-only access, you can read saved results in Chat outputs. Use the three dots to pin the agent or copy a link for someone who already has access.

comment.text: Body of the AI Agents onboarding tour step that highlights the first agent row in the list; variant for non-admin users (admins see AgentRow). Chat outputs is the UI name of a section; the three dots are the row's menu button.

usage.context:
// 4. An agent row; a user gets other wording.
 hasItems &&
 fileItemStep(
 FIRST_ITEM_SELECTOR,
 t("AiAgentsTour:AgentRowTitle"),
 isAdmin ? t("AiAgentsTour:AgentRow") : t("AiAgentsTour:AgentRowMember"),
 callbacks,
 AI_AGENTS_TOUR_LABEL,
 leaveAgent,
 ),
